Self-restore item. (1/4 max HP, Hold)

Useful berry for when you drop below half HP, as it heals 25%. Can be the difference between living a hit and not!

I like this when I remember to harvest and plant berries. Also works nice with Substitute, if the Sub cost drops you low enough to trigger it.
